summary: Frontend testing of new GPS Tracking feature (HaulCheck). Verified: manager Tracking nav+page, Leaflet map + OSM tiles rendering, driver list with live badge, John Smith route history (3 points, polyline+start/end markers, date-select, point-count, back), staff role gating (nav-tracking hidden), driver PWA Start/End Shift toggle with mocked geolocation, and full end-to-end link (Jane Doe on-shift appears live on manager map with route points). All acceptance criteria met — no bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: ShiftTracker: navigator.geolocation.watchPosition with a static mocked position only fires once, so pointsSent stays at 1 even after 20s. Real devices moving will produce more pings; consider a fallback getCurrentPosition() on an interval to catch stationary drivers. Not blocking.
Tracking.js: /tracking/live is polled every 30s but errors are silently swallowed (setLoading(false) only). Consider surfacing repeated failures via a toast so managers know if the feed is stale.

Tracking driver list may show duplicate driver names (observed 'John Smith' appearing twice — one with vehicle, one without). Not a bug in this feature, but suggests the drivers collection has duplicates on the manager account — worth flagging.
